title: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
description: A self-styled Lothario (Ryan Gosling) teaches a suddenly single 40-something (Steve Carell) how to be a hit with the ladies.

title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
description: A scientist's quest to find a cure for Alzheimer's disease unintentionally results in a highly intelligent chimpanzee, which may signal the end of man's dominion over Earth.

title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
description: Human survivors of a plague threaten Caesar's growing nation of genetically evolved apes. Though they reach a fragile peace, soon both sides are brought to the brink of a war that will determine which will become Earth's dominant species.

title: War for the Planet of the Apes
description: A ruthless colonel (Woody Harrelson) leads his troops in a deadly battle against Caesar (Andy Serkis) and his army of intelligent apes.

title: Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes
description: Many years after the reign of Caesar, a young ape goes on a journey that will lead him to question everything he's been taught about the past and make choices that will define a future for apes and humans alike.

title: Contagion
description: The world panics as doctors race to find a cure for a rapidly spreading virus that kills those contaminated within days.

title: Repo Men
description: Set in the future when artificial organs can be bought on credit, a man struggles to make the payments on a heart he has purchased. He must go on the run before the heart is repossessed.

title: Nanny McPhee Returns
description: Magical Nanny McPhee helps a harried mother who is trying to care for five children and tend to the family farm while her husband is away at war.

title: Hidden Figures
description: NASA mathematicians Katherine Johnson, Dorothy Vaughan and Mary Jackson cross gender and race lines to help launch astronaut John Glenn into outer space.

title: Lord of the Flies
description: English schoolboys (James Aubrey, Tom Chapin, Hugh Edwards), stranded on a desert island without adults, soon turn savage.

title: The Darkest Minds
description: When teens mysteriously develop powerful new abilities, they are declared a threat by the government and detained. Betrayed by the adults in power, they must use their collective powers to wage a resistance and take back their future.

title: Dumb Money
description: Everyday people flip the script on Wall Street and get rich by turning GameStop into one of the world's hottest companies. In the middle of everything is Keith Gill, a regular guy who starts it all by sinking his life savings into the stock.

title: Adult Best Friends
description: Katie takes her best friend on a nostalgic trip to their hometown to tell her she's getting married. Their journey soon takes some unexpected turns courtesy of a bizarre rental homeowner, a bachelor party, and a few potential love interests.

title: A Thousand Words
description: A fast-talking literary agent (Eddie Murphy) must learn how to live without speech upon discovering that he has only a thousand words left to say before he dies.

title: The Judge
description: A slick Chicago lawyer (Robert Downey Jr.) returns home to Indiana upon the passing of his mother, then soon becomes engaged in defending his estranged father (Robert Duvall), a recovering alcoholic who will be tried for a hit-and-run death.

title: X-Men: First Class
description: Charles Xavier and Erik Lehnsherr work with other mutants to prevent a nuclear nightmare, but a situation soon tears the close friends apart.

title: Broken City
description: A former cop (Mark Wahlberg) becomes embroiled in a bigger scandal than he realized after being hired to tail the cheating wife of the mayor (Russell Crowe).

title: The Alto Knights
description: The Alto Knights follow two of New York's most notorious crime bosses and how their separate paths to power place them on a deadly collision course.

title: The Art of Getting By
description: A high-school senior (Freddie Highmore) has a fatalistic outlook on life but slowly starts to change his view after meeting a free-spirited classmate (Emma Roberts).

title: Black Butterfly
description: A down-on-his luck screenwriter picks up a drifter and offers him a place to stay, not knowing that soon he'll become a prisoner, forced to write for a deranged stranger.

title: They All Laughed
description: New York private eyes (Ben Gazzara, John Ritter) fall for wives they've been hired by husbands to follow.

title: DC League of Super-Pets
description: Krypto the Super-Dog must convince a ragtag group of animals to master their own newfound powers to help him save Superman and the rest of the Justice League.

title: Get Him to the Greek
description: A record-company employee (Jonah Hill) has just a few days to get a boozy British rock star (Russell Brand) to Hollywood for a big comeback concert.

title: The Dilemma
description: As an important presentation nears, a business partner (Vince Vaughn) agonizes over whether to tell his associate and friend (Kevin James) that he saw the man's wife out with another guy.

title: MacGruber
description: After his sworn enemy steals a nuclear warhead, a clueless soldier-of-fortune (Will Forte) leads a skilled team on a mission to retrieve the device and bring the thief to justice.

title: Mojave
description: A down-and-out artist (Garrett Hedlund) has a dangerous and shocking encounter with an evil drifter (Oscar Isaac) in the desert, leading to terrifying consequences when the deadly stranger follows his unsuspecting victim home.

title: Arctic
description: A man stranded in the Arctic after an airplane crash must decide whether to remain in the relative safety of his makeshift camp or to embark on a deadly trek through the unknown in hopes of making it out alive.

title: The Meg
description: A massive creature attacks a deep-sea submersible, leaving it disabled and trapping the crew at the bottom of the Pacific Ocean. With time running out, a rescue diver must now confront an unimaginable threat, a 75-foot-long prehistoric shark.

title: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
description: Still haunted by Beetlejuice, Lydia's life gets turned upside down when her daughter discovers a portal to the afterlife. When someone says Beetlejuice's name three times, the mischievous demon returns to unleash his very own brand of mayhem.

title: Black Adam
description: Bestowed with the almighty powers of the gods, Black Adam's unique form of justice, born out of rage, is challenged by modern-day heroes who form the Justice Society: Hawkman, Dr. Fate, Atom Smasher and Cyclone.

title: Atomic Blonde
description: With the Berlin Wall about to fall, an elite MI6 spy travels into the heart of the city to retrieve a priceless dossier and take down a ruthless espionage ring.

title: Spring Breakers
description: Four college friends (Vanessa Hudgens, Selena Gomez, Ashley Benson, Rachel Korine) are arrested after robbing a restaurant to fund their spring-break trip. They land in more trouble when a drug and arms dealer bails them out to do some dirty work.

title: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri
description: After a 50-year-old woman's (Frances McDormand) daughter is murdered, she confronts the police (Caleb Landry Jones, Kerry Condon) in her town, using the billboards on the outskirts of town to begin a smear campaign against them.

title: Aftermath
description: Two strangers' lives become inextricably bound together after an error by an air traffic controller (Scoot McNairy) causes the death of a construction foreman's (Arnold Schwarzenegger) wife and daughter.

title: Mid90s
description: In the 1990s Los Angeles, a 13-year-old spends his summer navigating between a troubled home life and a crew of new friends he meets at a skate shop.

title: Hoot
description: After moving from Montana, a youth and his new friends in Florida take on corrupt politicians and greedy developers in a fight to protect endangered owls.

title: It's Kind of a Funny Story
description: A depressed teenager (Keir Gilchrist) checks himself into a psychiatric facility and winds up in the adult ward, where a fellow patient (Zach Galifianakis) takes him under his wing.

title: The Switch
description: A woman (Jennifer Aniston) inseminates herself without knowing that her best friend (Jason Bateman) substituted her preferred sperm sample for his own.

title: Game Night
description: A couple's weekly game night gets kicked up a notch when their friends agree to participate in a murder mystery party. They soon find themselves in over their heads as each twist leads to another unexpected turn over the course of one chaotic night.

title: A Good Day to Die Hard
description: New York City cop John McClane (Bruce Willis) and his estranged son (Jai Courtney) must put aside their differences and work together to get a Russian whistleblower to safety and thwart a disastrous crime in Chernobyl.

title: The Transporter Refueled
description: Former special-operations mercenary Frank Martin (Ed Skrein) utilizes his covert skills when a femme fatale (Loan Chabanol) uses him as a pawn in her vengeful scheme against the human trafficker (Camille Delamarre) who victimized her years earlier.

title: Scream
description: A psycho killer targets a past victim's daughter (Neve Campbell), while a tabloid TV reporter (Courteney Cox) homes in on his identity.

title: Us
description: A couple and their two children must fight for survival when four masked strangers descend upon their beachfront home. When the masks come off, the family is horrified to learn that each attacker takes the appearance of one of them.

title: The Nun
description: Vatican officials send a priest and a novitiate to investigate the suicide of a young nun in Romania. They soon find themselves in a fight for their lives when they encounter a demonic force that takes the shape of a nun.

title: Batman
description: The Caped Crusader (Michael Keaton) saves dismal Gotham City and gorgeous Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger) from the freaky Joker (Jack Nicholson).

title: Inconceivable
description: Angela develops a friendship with a mysterious woman named Katie and offers her a job as a live-in nanny. The natural bond soon turns into a dangerous obsession as Katie becomes overly attached to the family's young daughter.

title: 3 Days to Kill
description: A dying Secret Service agent (Kevin Costner) who wants to reconnect with his estranged daughter (Hailee Steinfeld) is offered a potentially lifesaving drug in exchange for completing one final mission.

title: Chasing Mavericks
description: Hearing that the mythic Mavericks surf break is real, a teenage surfer (Jonny Weston) asks a local legend (Gerard Butler) to teach him how to ride the wave and live to tell the tale.
